title: Live Stream Indicator
content: Build live stream UI components. Live badge: pulsing red "LIVE" indicator. Viewer count: eye icon with count, updates real-time. Stream preview: thumbnail with live badge overlay. Join prompt: "Join Live" button. Go live: button to start streaming. Notifications: "[User] is live!" toast.

variants.simple: Create live streaming status badge and viewer count.
variants.detailed: Build live stream UI components. Live badge: pulsing red "LIVE" indicator. Viewer count: eye icon with count, updates real-time. Stream preview: thumbnail with live badge overlay. Join prompt: "Join Live" button. Go live: button to start streaming. Notifications: "[User] is live!" toast.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive live stream UI components and indicators. Live badge component: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-500 text-white text-xs font-semibold. Pulsing dot: w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-white animate-pulse before text. "LIVE" text. Sizes: small for thumbnails, medium for headers. Stream thumbnail card: aspect-video relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden. Video preview: actual live preview frame or static poster with play overlay. Live badge: absolute top-2 left-2. Viewer count: absolute top-2 right-2 bg-black/70 text-white rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-sm, Eye icon + count (updates real-time). Duration: optional "Live for 1h 23m" timestamp. Stream info overlay: absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 p-3. Stream title (text-white font-medium line-clamp-1), streamer info (avatar w-6 h-6, name). Hover: scale-105 transform with shadow. Click: navigates to stream. Profile live indicator: when user is live, red ring around avatar (ring-2 ring-red-500), small LIVE badge below avatar. Story-style: in story tray, live users have distinct red ring vs gradient ring. "Go Live" button: for users with streaming enabled, Camera icon + "Go Live" button in composer or profile. Opens stream setup (title, thumbnail, visibility, save stream toggle). Live notifications: when followed user goes live, toast notification "[User] is live: [Stream title]", tap opens stream. Push notification: "🔴 [User] started a live video". Feed integration: live streams appear in feed with live badge, auto-promoted to top of feed. Viewer list: expandable showing current viewers with avatars. Live comments: real-time scrolling chat overlay. React to stream: reaction animations floating up. Join prompt: for discovered streams, "Watch Live" prominent CTA. Stream ended: "Live has ended" state with replay option if saved. Schedule live: "Schedule a live video" with date/time picker, reminder signup for followers. Multi-host: indicators for co-hosts in stream. Accessibility: live status announced, viewer count updates not disruptive, stream content describable.
